title: How AI agents negotiate prices autonomously

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Autonomous price negotiation via AI is faster, fairer, and eliminates human bias — the "how" is a clear win.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: AI lacks context — it can't grasp market sentiment, cultural nuances, or sudden demand spikes. It's just code.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Real-time data feeds and ML models adjust instantly — like Amazon's dynamic pricing, but with ethical guardrails.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: No algorithm can replicate human negotiation tactics — empathy, persuasion, and strategic concessions matter.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future isn't human or AI — it's protocol-driven AI that scales, learns, and negotiates better than any human ever could.
